subject: physical-education

standardsMappingAuthority.note: Standards remain governed by the bound production package.

instructions: Complete the safe activity or accessible equivalent and document the requested performance evidence.
Stop for pain, dizziness, breathing trouble, unsafe conditions, or missing adult supervision.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain the critical features or key principle of sending, receiving, and carrying an object under light pressure in your own words.
Demonstrate or fully describe creating and denying space using a version your body and setting allow. A described or adapted version earns full credit.
Apply support angles and off-object movement in a new situation and explain the decision or adjustment you made.
Analyze a plausible technique fault, tactical error, or unsafe choice involving transition between attacking and defending; correct it and explain why.
Connect shared rules, fair play, and safe contact limits with adapting an activity so everyone present can play it and explain how one affects the other.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Demonstrate the core invasion skills and explain one tactical principle using a diagram or description, then modify the activity so a person with a different mobility profile can play the same game.
Identify one thing you can now do or direct yourself, one adjustment that improved it, and one next goal you set for yourself.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated safe participation and self-management criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated skill cues or movement quality criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated tactical or training reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated self-assessment and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. An adapted or described performance is full credit, not partial credit.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Movement Competence: Invasion Activity Category?
